        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Normalize both sightings and events data into a common format for analysis\n *\n * @param sightingsData - Array of sightings data\n * @param eventsData - Array of events data\n * @returns Normalized data array\n */\nfunction normalizeDataForAnalysis(\n\tsightingsData: SightingData[],\n\teventsData: EventData[],\n): Array\u003c{\n\tid: string;\n\ttype: \"sighting\" | \"event\";\n\ttitle: string;\n\tdescription: string;\n\tdate: Date;\n\tlocation: {\n\t\tname: string;\n\t\tcoordinates?: { lat: number; lng: number };\n\t};\n\tshape?: string;\n\tcategory?: string | string[];\n\toriginalItem: SightingData | EventData;\n}\u003e {\n\t// Process sightings\n\tconst normalizedSightings = sightingsData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: \"sighting\" as const,\n\t\t\ttitle: item.title || \"UAP Sighting\",\n\t\t\tdescription: item.content,\n\t\t\tdate: item.timestamp,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: item.location?.city || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates: item.location?.coordinates,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tshape: item.shape || item.category?.[0],\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item,\n\t\t};\n\t});\n\n\t// Process events\n\tconst normalizedEvents = eventsData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: \"event\" as const,\n\t\t\ttitle: item.title || item.name || \"Event\",\n\t\t\tdescription: item.description,\n\t\t\tdate: item.date,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: item.location || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates:\n\t\t\t\t\titem.latitude \u0026\u0026 item.longitude\n\t\t\t\t\t\t? { lat: item.latitude, lng: item.longitude }\n\t\t\t\t\t\t: undefined,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item,\n\t\t};\n\t});\n\n\t// Combine and return\n\treturn [...normalizedSightings, ...normalizedEvents];\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Normalize both sightings and events data into a common format for analysis\n *\n * @param sightingsData - Array of sightings data\n * @param eventsData - Array of events data\n * @returns Normalized data array\n */\nfunction normalizeDataForAnalysis(\n\tsightingsData: SightingData[],\n\teventsData: EventData[],\n): Array\u003c{\n\tid: string;\n\ttype: \"sighting\" | \"event\";\n\ttitle: string;\n\tdescription: string;\n\tdate: Date;\n\tlocation: {\n\t\tname: string;\n\t\tcoordinates?: { lat: number; lng: number };\n\t};\n\tshape?: string;\n\tcategory?: string | string[];\n\toriginalItem: SightingData | EventData;\n}\u003e {\n\t// Process sightings\n\tconst normalizedSightings = sightingsData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: \"sighting\" as const,\n\t\t\ttitle: item.title || \"UAP Sighting\",\n\t\t\tdescription: item.content,\n\t\t\tdate: item.timestamp,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: item.location?.city || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates: item.location?.coordinates,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tshape: item.shape || item.category?.[0],\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item,\n\t\t};\n\t});\n\n\t// Process events\n\tconst normalizedEvents = eventsData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: \"event\" as const,\n\t\t\ttitle: item.title || item.name || \"Event\",\n\t\t\tdescription: item.description,\n\t\t\tdate: item.date,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: item.location || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates:\n\t\t\t\t\titem.latitude \u0026\u0026 item.longitude\n\t\t\t\t\t\t? { lat: item.latitude, lng: item.longitude }\n\t\t\t\t\t\t: undefined,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item,\n\t\t};\n\t});\n\n\t// Combine and return\n\treturn [...normalizedSightings, ...normalizedEvents];\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Prepares a summary of combined sightings and events data for AI analysis\n *\n * @param normalizedData - Normalized data array containing both sightings and events\n * @returns Summarized data suitable for AI analysis\n */\nfunction prepareCombinedDataSummary(\n\tnormalizedData: Array\u003c{\n\t\tid: string;\n\t\ttype: \"sighting\" | \"event\";\n\t\ttitle: string;\n\t\tdescription: string;\n\t\tdate: Date;\n\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\tname: string;\n\t\t\tcoordinates?: { lat: number; lng: number };\n\t\t};\n\t\tshape?: string;\n\t\tcategory?: string | string[];\n\t\toriginalItem: SightingData | EventData;\n\t}\u003e,\n) {\n\t// Limit the number of full descriptions to avoid token limits\n\tconst MAX_FULL_DESCRIPTIONS = 50;\n\n\t// Separate sightings and events\n\tconst sightings = normalizedData.filter((item) =\u003e item.type === \"sighting\");\n\tconst events = normalizedData.filter((item) =\u003e item.type === \"event\");\n\n\t// Create a combined summary\n\tconst summary = {\n\t\ttotalSightings: sightings.length,\n\t\ttotalEvents: events.length,\n\t\tlocationData: normalizedData.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\tlocation: item.location?.name || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\tcoordinates: item.location?.coordinates || null,\n\t\t})),\n\t\ttemporalData: normalizedData.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\tdate: item.date,\n\t\t})),\n\t\tshapeData: sightings.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\tshape: item.shape || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t})),\n\t\tcategoryData: events.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t})),\n\t\t// Limit full descriptions to save tokens\n\t\tdescriptions: normalizedData\n\t\t\t.slice(0, MAX_FULL_DESCRIPTIONS)\n\t\t\t.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\t\tdescription: item.description || \"No description\",\n\t\t\t})),\n\t};\n\n\treturn summary;\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Prepares a summary of combined sightings and events data for AI analysis\n *\n * @param normalizedData - Normalized data array containing both sightings and events\n * @returns Summarized data suitable for AI analysis\n */\nfunction prepareCombinedDataSummary(\n\tnormalizedData: Array\u003c{\n\t\tid: string;\n\t\ttype: \"sighting\" | \"event\";\n\t\ttitle: string;\n\t\tdescription: string;\n\t\tdate: Date;\n\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\tname: string;\n\t\t\tcoordinates?: { lat: number; lng: number };\n\t\t};\n\t\tshape?: string;\n\t\tcategory?: string | string[];\n\t\toriginalItem: SightingData | EventData;\n\t}\u003e,\n) {\n\t// Limit the number of full descriptions to avoid token limits\n\tconst MAX_FULL_DESCRIPTIONS = 50;\n\n\t// Separate sightings and events\n\tconst sightings = normalizedData.filter((item) =\u003e item.type === \"sighting\");\n\tconst events = normalizedData.filter((item) =\u003e item.type === \"event\");\n\n\t// Create a combined summary\n\tconst summary = {\n\t\ttotalSightings: sightings.length,\n\t\ttotalEvents: events.length,\n\t\tlocationData: normalizedData.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\tlocation: item.location?.name || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\tcoordinates: item.location?.coordinates || null,\n\t\t})),\n\t\ttemporalData: normalizedData.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\tdate: item.date,\n\t\t})),\n\t\tshapeData: sightings.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\tshape: item.shape || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t})),\n\t\tcategoryData: events.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t})),\n\t\t// Limit full descriptions to save tokens\n\t\tdescriptions: normalizedData\n\t\t\t.slice(0, MAX_FULL_DESCRIPTIONS)\n\t\t\t.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\t\tdescription: item.description || \"No description\",\n\t\t\t})),\n\t};\n\n\treturn summary;\n}",

        "contents": "export const analyzeSightingsData = async (\n...\nexport const analyzeSightingsData = async (\n...\nexport const analyzeSightingsData = async (\n\n\n\t\t...\n\n\n\t\t// Create user prompt with the combined data\n\t\tconst userPrompt = &#96;Analyze the following combined UFO sightings and events data and provide structured insights:\\n\\n${JSON.stringify(dataSummary, null, 2)}&#96;;\n\n\t\t// Create streamable value for incremental updates\n\t\tconst stream = createStreamableValue();\n\n\t\t// Make the OpenAI API call with streaming\n\t\tconst { partialObjectStream } = await streamObject({\n\t\t\tmodel: openai.responses(\"gpt-4-turbo-preview\"),\n\t\t\tsystem: systemPrompt,\n\t\t\tprompt: userPrompt,\n\t\t\tschema: analysisSchema,\n\t\t});\n\n\t\tconsole.log(\n\t\t\t\"🚀 ~ analyzeSightingsData ~ API call initiated for combined data analysis\",\n\t\t);\n\n\t\t// Process the streaming response\n\t\tfor await (const partialObject of partialObjectStream) {\n\t\t\tconsole.log(\n\t\t\t\t\"🚀 ~ analyzeSightingsData ~ partialObject update:\",\n\t\t\t\tObject.keys(partialObject).length,\n\t\t\t);\n\t\t\tstream.update(partialObject);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tstream.done;\n\n\t\t// Return both the analysis and the streaming value\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tanalysis: stream.value as SightingsAnalysisResult,\n\t\t\tstreamingValue: stream,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error analyzing combined data:\", error);\n\t\tthrow new Error(\n\t\t\t&#96;Failed to analyze combined data: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}&#96;,\n\t\t);\n\t}\n};",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for events based on time range\n * Uses Xata's aggregate functionality for efficient computation\n */\nexport async function getEventsStats(\n\tstartYear = 1940,\n\tendYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n) {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Calculate date range\n\t\tconst startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n\t\tconst endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n\t\t// Use Xata's aggregate with top-level filter\n\t\tconst categoryAggregation = (await xata.db.events.aggregate(\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tcategoryDistribution: {\n\t\t\t\t\ttopValues: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcolumn: \"category\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tsize: 20,\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t)) as unknown as XataAggregationResult;\n\n\t\t// Get time series data by year\n\t\tconst timeSeriesAggregation = (await xata.db.events.aggregate(\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\teventsByYear: {\n\t\t\t\t\tdateHistogram: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcolumn: \"date\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcalendarInterval: \"year\",\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t)) as unknown as XataAggregationResult;\n\n\t\t// Fetch all events to process location data with coordinates\n\t\tconst eventsRecords = await xata.db.events\n\t\t\t.filter({\n\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t.getAll();\n\n\t\t// Process location data to include coordinates\n\t\tconst locationGroups = new Map\u003c\n\t\t\tstring,\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tlocation: string;\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates: { lat: number; lng: number } | null;\n\t\t\t\tcount: number;\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\u003e();",

        "contents": "const results = await xata.db.titles.aggregate({\n  movieGenres: {\n    topValues: {\n      column: 'genre',\n      size: 50,\n      aggs: {\n        byReleaseDate: {\n          dateHistogram: {\n            column: 'releaseDate',\n            calendarInterval: 'year',\n            aggs: {\n              avgRating: {\n                average: {\n                  column: 'rating'\n                }\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nconst results = await xata.db.titles.aggregate({\n  movieGenres: {\n    topValues: {\n      column: 'genre',\n      size: 50,\n      aggs: {\n        byReleaseDate: {\n          dateHistogram: {\n            column: 'releaseDate',\n            calendarInterval: 'year',\n            aggs: {\n              avgRating: {\n                average: {\n                  column: 'rating'\n                }\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n},\n{\n  \"director\":\"Peter Jackson\"\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n# Data Analysis Prompts for Geospatial UFO Sighting Data\n\nBased on the data provided, I'll create several analysis prompts that would help an AI geospatial assistant extract meaningful insights from this UFO sighting dataset.\n\n## Spatial Analysis Prompts\n\n1. \"Generate a heatmap visualization showing the concentration of UFO sightings across the United States. Identify any notable geographic clusters or hotspots.\"\n2. \"Analyze the distribution of UFO sightings in coastal versus inland cities. Is there a statistically significant difference in sighting frequency?\"\n3. \"Compare UFO sighting rates in the top 10 cities with highest counts, adjusting for population density. Which locations have the highest per capita sighting rates?\"\n4. \"Examine the spatial correlation between major airport locations and high-frequency UFO sighting cities. Are sightings more common near air traffic hubs?\"\n5. \"Map the geographic distribution of triangle-shaped UFO sightings versus disk-shaped sightings. Do certain shapes appear more frequently in specific regions?\"\n\n## Pattern Analysis Prompts\n\n1. \"Analyze whether there's a correlation between UFO shape and geographic location. For example, are 'fireball' sightings more common in desert regions like Arizona and Nevada?\"\n2. \"Identify any regional preferences in UFO shape reporting. Do witnesses in the Pacific Northwest report different shapes than those in the Southeast?\"\n3. \"Determine if there's a correlation between city elevation and specific UFO shapes reported, particularly for 'light' and 'fireball' sightings.\"\n4. \"Examine whether cities with high tourism rates (like Las Vegas, Orlando) report different UFO shapes compared to less tourism-focused cities.\"\n5. \"Compare sighting frequencies between major metropolitan areas versus smaller cities. Is there a population threshold that correlates with increased sighting reports?\"\n\n## Temporal-Spatial Analysis Prompts\n\n1. \"Create a time-series analysis of UFO sightings in Las Vegas, Phoenix, and Orlando over the past decade. Identify any seasonal patterns or yearly trends.\"\n2. \"Analyze night-time light pollution data against UFO sighting frequencies for the top 30 cities. Do areas with more light pollution report more or fewer sightings?\"\n3. \"Examine the correlation between local weather patterns and UFO sighting reports in the top reporting cities. Are sightings more common during certain weather conditions?\"\n4. \"Map the progression of UFO sighting waves across geographic regions. Do sightings tend to cluster temporally and spatially?\"\n5. \"Analyze whether military base proximity correlates with specific UFO shape reports, particularly 'triangle' and 'chevron' shaped objects.\"\n\n## Visualization Prompts\n\n1. \"Create an interactive map visualization that shows the distribution of different UFO shapes across the United States, with the ability to filter by shape category.\"\n2. \"Develop a 3D terrain visualization showing UFO sighting densities overlaid on topographical features to identify any correlation with landscape features.\"\n3. \"Generate a comparative dashboard showing the top 5 reported UFO shapes in the 10 cities with highest sighting frequencies.\"\n4. \"Create a network analysis visualization showing relationships between neighboring cities with similar UFO shape reporting patterns.\"\n5. \"Develop a multi-layer map that overlays UFO sighting data with astronomical events, air traffic patterns, and military training exercise schedules to identify potential correlations.\"\n\nThese prompts should provide a solid foundation for extracting valuable insights from your UFO sighting dataset using a geospatial AI assistant.             "text": "5. \"Compare sighting frequencies between major metropolitan areas versus smaller cities. Is there a population threshold that correlates with increased sighting reports?\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88,
            "text": "## Temporal-Spatial Analysis Prompts"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90,
            "text": "1. \"Create a time-series analysis of UFO sightings in Las Vegas, Phoenix, and Orlando over the past decade. Identify any seasonal patterns or yearly trends.\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91,
            "text": "2. \"Analyze night-time light pollution data against UFO sighting frequencies for the top 30 cities. Do areas with more light pollution report more or fewer sightings?\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92,
            "text": "3. \"Examine the correlation between local weather patterns and UFO sighting reports in the top reporting cities. Are sightings more common during certain weather conditions?\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93,
            "text": "4. \"Map the progression of UFO sighting waves across geographic regions. Do sightings tend to cluster temporally and spatially?\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 94,
            "text": "5. \"Analyze whether military base proximity correlates with specific UFO shape reports, particularly 'triangle' and 'chevron' shaped objects.\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96,
            "text": "## Visualization Prompts"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98,
            "text": "1. \"Create an interactive map visualization that shows the distribution of different UFO shapes across the United States, with the ability to filter by shape category.\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 99,
            "text": "2. \"Develop a 3D terrain visualization showing UFO sighting densities overlaid on topographical features to identify any correlation with landscape features.\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100,
            "text": "3. \"Generate a comparative dashboard showing the top 5 reported UFO shapes in the 10 cities with highest sighting frequencies.\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101,
            "text": "4. \"Create a network analysis visualization showing relationships between neighboring cities with similar UFO shape reporting patterns.\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 102,
            "text": "5. \"Develop a multi-layer map that overlays UFO sighting data with astronomical events, air traffic patterns, and military training exercise schedules to identify potential correlations.\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 104,
            "text": "These prompts should provide a solid foundation for extracting valuable insights from your UFO sighting dataset using a geospatial AI assistant. They cover spatial patterns, temporal trends, and comparative analyses that would be most relevant for understanding the geographic distribution of these phenomena."

        "originalContents": "const results = await xata.db.titles.aggregate({\n  movieGenres: {\n    topValues: {\n      column: 'genre',\n      size: 50,\n      aggs: {\n        byReleaseDate: {\n          dateHistogram: {\n            column: 'releaseDate',\n            calendarInterval: 'year',\n            aggs: {\n              avgRating: {\n                average: {\n                  column: 'rating'\n                }\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nconst results = await xata.db.titles.aggregate({\n  movieGenres: {\n    topValues: {\n      column: 'genre',\n      size: 50,\n      aggs: {\n        byReleaseDate: {\n          dateHistogram: {\n            column: 'releaseDate',\n            calendarInterval: 'year',\n            aggs: {\n              avgRating: {\n                average: {\n                  column: 'rating'\n                }\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n},\n{\n  \"director\":\"Peter Jackson\"\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n# Data Analysis Prompts for Geospatial UFO Sighting Data\n\nBased on the data provided, I'll create several analysis prompts that would help an AI geospatial assistant extract meaningful insights from this UFO sighting dataset.\n\n## Spatial Analysis Prompts\n\n1. \"Generate a heatmap visualization showing the concentration of UFO sightings across the United States. Identify any notable geographic clusters or hotspots.\"\n2. \"Analyze the distribution of UFO sightings in coastal versus inland cities. Is there a statistically significant difference in sighting frequency?\"\n3. \"Compare UFO sighting rates in the top 10 cities with highest counts, adjusting for population density. Which locations have the highest per capita sighting rates?\"\n4. \"Examine the spatial correlation between major airport locations and high-frequency UFO sighting cities. Are sightings more common near air traffic hubs?\"\n5. \"Map the geographic distribution of triangle-shaped UFO sightings versus disk-shaped sightings. Do certain shapes appear more frequently in specific regions?\"\n\n## Pattern Analysis Prompts\n\n1. \"Analyze whether there's a correlation between UFO shape and geographic location. For example, are 'fireball' sightings more common in desert regions like Arizona and Nevada?\"\n2. \"Identify any regional preferences in UFO shape reporting. Do witnesses in the Pacific Northwest report different shapes than those in the Southeast?\"\n3. \"Determine if there's a correlation between city elevation and specific UFO shapes reported, particularly for 'light' and 'fireball' sightings.\"\n4. \"Examine whether cities with high tourism rates (like Las Vegas, Orlando) report different UFO shapes compared to less tourism-focused cities.\"\n5. \"Compare sighting frequencies between major metropolitan areas versus smaller cities. Is there a population threshold that correlates with increased sighting reports?\"\n\n## Temporal-Spatial Analysis Prompts\n\n1. \"Create a time-series analysis of UFO sightings in Las Vegas, Phoenix, and Orlando over the past decade. Identify any seasonal patterns or yearly trends.\"\n2. \"Analyze night-time light pollution data against UFO sighting frequencies for the top 30 cities. Do areas with more light pollution report more or fewer sightings?\"\n3. \"Examine the correlation between local weather patterns and UFO sighting reports in the top reporting cities. Are sightings more common during certain weather conditions?\"\n4. \"Map the progression of UFO sighting waves across geographic regions. Do sightings tend to cluster temporally and spatially?\"\n5. \"Analyze whether military base proximity correlates with specific UFO shape reports, particularly 'triangle' and 'chevron' shaped objects.\"\n\n## Visualization Prompts\n\n1. \"Create an interactive map visualization that shows the distribution of different UFO shapes across the United States, with the ability to filter by shape category.\"\n2. \"Develop a 3D terrain visualization showing UFO sighting densities overlaid on topographical features to identify any correlation with landscape features.\"\n3. \"Generate a comparative dashboard showing the top 5 reported UFO shapes in the 10 cities with highest sighting frequencies.\"\n4. \"Create a network analysis visualization showing relationships between neighboring cities with similar UFO shape reporting patterns.\"\n5. \"Develop a multi-layer map that overlays UFO sighting data with astronomical events, air traffic patterns, and military training exercise schedules to identify potential correlations.\"\n\nThese prompts should provide a solid foundation for extracting valuable insights from your UFO sighting dataset using a geospatial AI assistant. They cover spatial patterns, temporal trends, and comparative analyses that would be most relevant for understanding the geographic distribution of these phenomena.\n",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Fetch a paginated batch of events data with time ranges\n * @param timeRanges Array of time ranges to query\n * @param limit Maximum records per time range\n */\nexport async function getEventsBatched(\n\ttimeRanges: { startYear: number; endYear: number }[],\n\tlimit = 50,\n) {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Process batches in parallel\n\t\tconst batchPromises = timeRanges.map((range) =\u003e\n\t\t\tgetEventsByTimeChunk(range.startYear, range.endYear, limit),\n\t\t);\n\n\t\t// Stats for the full range\n\t\tconst startYear = Math.min(...timeRanges.map((r) =\u003e r.startYear));\n\t\tconst endYear = Math.max(...timeRanges.map((r) =\u003e r.endYear));\n\t\tconst statsPromise = getEventsStats(startYear, endYear);\n\n\t\t// Wait for all promises to resolve\n\t\tconst [batchResults, stats] = await Promise.all([\n\t\t\tPromise.all(batchPromises),\n\t\t\tstatsPromise,\n\t\t]);\n\n\t\t// Merge all batches\n\t\tconst allEvents = batchResults.flat();\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tevents: allEvents,\n\t\t\tstats,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error fetching batched events:\", error);\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tevents: [],\n\t\t\tstats: null,\n\t\t};\n\t}\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for events based on time range\n * Uses Xata's aggregate functionality for efficient computation\n */\nexport async function getEventsStats(\n\tstartYear = 1940,\n\tendYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n) {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Calculate date range\n\t\tconst startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n\t\tconst endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n\t\t// Use Xata's aggregate with top-level filter\n\t\tconst categoryAggregation = (await xata.db.events.aggregate(\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tcategoryDistribution: {\n\t\t\t\t\ttopValues: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcolumn: \"category\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tsize: 20,\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t)) as unknown as XataAggregationResult;\n\n\t\t// Get time series data by year\n\t\tconst timeSeriesAggregation = (await xata.db.events.aggregate(\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\teventsByYear: {\n\t\t\t\t\tdateHistogram: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcolumn: \"date\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcalendarInterval: \"year\",\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t)) as unknown as XataAggregationResult;\n\n\t\t// Fetch all events to process location data with coordinates\n\t\tconst eventsRecords = await xata.db.events\n\t\t\t.filter({\n\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t.getAll();\n\n\t\t// Process location data to include coordinates\n\t\tconst locationGroups = new Map\u003c\n\t\t\tstring,\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tlocation: string;\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates: { lat: number; lng: number } | null;\n\t\t\t\tcount: number;\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\u003e();",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Fetch events within a specified time range, with pagination\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query\n * @param limit Maximum number of records to return\n */\nexport async function getEventsByTimeChunk(\n\tstartYear = 1940,\n\tendYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n\tlimit = 100,\n) {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Calculate date range\n\t\tconst startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n\t\tconst endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n\t\t// Use Xata's filter to get events within date range\n\t\tconst eventsRecords = await xata.db.events\n\t\t\t.filter({\n\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t.sort(\"date\", \"desc\")\n\t\t\t.getPaginated({\n\t\t\t\tpagination: {\n\t\t\t\t\tsize: limit,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t});\n\n\t\treturn eventsRecords.records;\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error fetching events by time chunk:\", error);\n\t\treturn [];\n\t}\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Fetch events within a specified time range, with pagination\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query\n * @param limit Maximum number of records to return\n */\nexport async function getEventsByTimeChunk(\n\tstartYear = 1940,\n\tendYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n\tlimit = 100,\n) {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Calculate date range\n\t\tconst startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n\t\tconst endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n\t\t// Use Xata's filter to get events within date range\n\t\tconst eventsRecords = await xata.db.events\n\t\t\t.filter({\n\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t.sort(\"date\", \"desc\")\n\t\t\t.getPaginated({\n\t\t\t\tpagination: {\n\t\t\t\t\tsize: limit,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t});\n\n\t\treturn eventsRecords.records;\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error fetching events by time chunk:\", error);\n\t\treturn [];\n\t}\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\t\ttry {\n\t\t\tstats = await getSightingsStats(startYear, endYear);\n\t\t\tconsole.log(\"🔍 Stats from database aggregation:\", stats);\n\t\t} catch (error) {\n\t\t\tconsole.error(\n\t\t\t\t\"Error fetching stats from aggregation, calculating manually:\",\n\t\t\t\terror,\n\t\t\t);\n\n\t\t\t// Calculate stats manually from the sightings data\n\t\t\tconst byType: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n\t\t\tconst byYear: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n\t\t\tconst byLocation: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n\n\t\t\tfor (const sighting of allSightings) {\n\t\t\t\t// By type\n\t\t\t\tif (sighting.type) {\n\t\t\t\t\tbyType[sighting.type] = (byType[sighting.type] || 0) + 1;\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t// By year\n\t\t\t\tif (sighting.timestamp) {\n\t\t\t\t\tconst fullYear: number = new Date(sighting.timestamp).getFullYear();\n\t\t\t\t\tconst decadeStart = Math.floor(fullYear / 10) * 10;\n\t\t\t\t\tconst decadeLabel = &#96;${decadeStart}-${decadeStart + 9}&#96;;\n\t\t\t\t\tbyYear[decadeLabel] = (byYear[decadeLabel] || 0) + 1;\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t// By location\n\t\t\t\tconst location = sighting.location?.city;\n\t\t\t\tif (location) {\n\t\t\t\t\tbyLocation[location] = (byLocation[location] || 0) + 1;\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tstats = {\n\t\t\t\ttotalSightings: allSightings.length,\n\t\t\t\tbyType,\n\t\t\t\tbyYear,\n\t\t\t\tbyLocation,\n\t\t\t\ttimeRange: {\n\t\t\t\t\tstartYear,\n\t\t\t\t\tendYear,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t};\n\t\t\tconsole.log(\"🔍 Stats calculated manually:\", stats);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsightings: allSightings,\n\t\t\tstats,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error fetching batched sightings:\", error);\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsightings: [],\n\t\t\tstats: {\n\t\t\t\ttotalSightings: 0,\n\t\t\t\tbyType: {},\n\t\t\t\tbyYear: {},\n\t\t\t\tbyLocation: {},\n\t\t\t\ttimeRange: {\n\t\t\t\t\tstartYear: timeRanges[0]?.startYear || 1940,\n\t\t\t\t\tendYear:\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttimeRanges[timeRanges.length -       "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Prepares a summary of combined sightings and events data for AI analysis\n *\n * @param normalizedData - Normalized data array containing both sightings and events\n * @returns Summarized data suitable for AI analysis\n */\nfunction prepareCombinedDataSummary(\n\tnormalizedData: Array\u003c{\n\t\tid: string;\n\t\ttype: \"sighting\" | \"event\";\n\t\ttitle: string;\n\t\tdescription: string;\n\t\tdate: Date;\n\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\tname: string;\n\t\t\tcoordinates?: { lat: number; lng: number };\n\t\t};\n\t\tshape?: string;\n\t\tcategory?: string | string[];\n\t\toriginalItem: SightingData | EventData;\n\t}\u003e,\n) {\n\t// Limit the number of full descriptions to avoid token limits\n\tconst MAX_FULL_DESCRIPTIONS = 50;\n\n\t// Separate sightings and events\n\tconst sightings = normalizedData.filter((item) =\u003e item.type === \"sighting\");\n\tconst events = normalizedData.filter((item) =\u003e item.type === \"event\");\n\n\t// Create a combined summary\n\tconst summary = {\n\t\ttotalSightings: sightings.length,\n\t\ttotalEvents: events.length,\n\t\tlocationData: normalizedData.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\tlocation: item.location?.name || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\tcoordinates: item.location?.coordinates || null,\n\t\t})),\n\t\ttemporalData: normalizedData.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\tdate: item.date,\n\t\t})),\n\t\tshapeData: sightings.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\tshape: item.shape || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t})),\n\t\tcategoryData: events.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t})),\n\t\t// Limit full descriptions to save tokens\n\t\tdescriptions: normalizedData\n\t\t\t.slice(0, MAX_FULL_DESCRIPTIONS)\n\t\t\t.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\t\tdescription: item.description || \"No description\",\n\t\t\t})),\n\t};\n\n\treturn summary;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Normalize both sightings and events data into a common format for analysis\n *\n * @param sightingsData - Array of sightings data\n * @param eventsData - Array of events data\n * @returns Normalized data array\n */\nfunction normalizeDataForAnalysis(\n\tsightingsData: SightingData[],\n\teventsData: EventData[],\n): Array\u003c{\n\tid: string;\n\ttype: \"sighting\" | \"event\";\n\ttitle: string;\n\tdescription: string;\n\tdate: Date;\n\tlocation: {\n\t\tname: string;\n\t\tcoordinates?: { lat: number; lng: number };\n\t};\n\tshape?: string;\n\tcategory?: string | string[];\n\toriginalItem: SightingData | EventData;\n}\u003e {\n\t// Process sightings\n\tconst normalizedSightings = sightingsData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: \"sighting\" as const,\n\t\t\ttitle: item.title || \"UAP Sighting\",\n\t\t\tdescription: item.content,\n\t\t\tdate: item.timestamp,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: item.location?.city || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates: item.location?.coordinates,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tshape: item.shape || item.category?.[0],\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item,\n\t\t};\n\t});\n\n\t// Process events\n\tconst normalizedEvents = eventsData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: \"event\" as const,\n\t\t\ttitle: item.title || item.name || \"Event\",\n\t\t\tdescription: item.description,\n\t\t\tdate: item.date,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: item.location || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates:\n\t\t\t\t\titem.latitude \u0026\u0026 item.longitude\n\t\t\t\t\t\t? { lat: item.latitude, lng: item.longitude }\n\t\t\t\t\t\t: undefined,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item,\n\t\t};\n\t});\n\n\t// Combine and return\n\treturn [...normalizedSightings, ...normalizedEvents];\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Normalize both sightings and events data into a common format for analysis\n *\n * @param sightingsData - Array of sightings data\n * @param eventsData - Array of events data\n * @returns Normalized data array\n */\nfunction normalizeDataForAnalysis(\n\tsightingsData: SightingData[],\n\teventsData: EventData[],\n): Array\u003c{\n\tid: string;\n\ttype: \"sighting\" | \"event\";\n\ttitle: string;\n\tdescription: string;\n\tdate: Date;\n\tlocation: {\n\t\tname: string;\n\t\tcoordinates?: { lat: number; lng: number };\n\t};\n\tshape?: string;\n\tcategory?: string | string[];\n\toriginalItem: SightingData | EventData;\n}\u003e {\n\t// Process sightings\n\tconst normalizedSightings = sightingsData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: \"sighting\" as const,\n\t\t\ttitle: item.title || \"UAP Sighting\",\n\t\t\tdescription: item.content,\n\t\t\tdate: item.timestamp,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: item.location?.city || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates: item.location?.coordinates,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tshape: item.shape || item.category?.[0],\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item,\n\t\t};\n\t});\n\n\t// Process events\n\tconst normalizedEvents = eventsData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: \"event\" as const,\n\t\t\ttitle: item.title || item.name || \"Event\",\n\t\t\tdescription: item.description,\n\t\t\tdate: item.date,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: item.location || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates:\n\t\t\t\t\titem.latitude \u0026\u0026 item.longitude\n\t\t\t\t\t\t? { lat: item.latitude, lng: item.longitude }\n\t\t\t\t\t\t: undefined,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item,\n\t\t};\n\t});\n\n\t// Combine and return\n\treturn [...normalizedSightings, ...normalizedEvents];\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Fetch sightings within a specified time chunk using Xata's aggregate functionality\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query\n * @param limit Maximum number of records to return\n */\nexport async function getSightingsByTimeChunk(\n\tstartYear = 1940,\n\tendYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n\tlimit = 100,\n): Promise\u003cValidatedUAPSighting[]\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Calculate date range using UTC for consistent timezone handling\n\t\tconst startDate = new Date(Date.UTC(startYear, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0));\n\t\tconst endDate = new Date(Date.UTC(endYear, 11, 31, 23, 59, 59, 999));\n\n\t\tconsole.log(\n\t\t\t\"🔍 Fetching sightings for year range:\",\n\t\t\tstartYear,\n\t\t\t\"to\",\n\t\t\tendYear,\n\t\t);\n\t\tconsole.log(\n\t\t\t\"🔍 Date range:\",\n\t\t\tstartDate.toISOString(),\n\t\t\t\"to\",\n\t\t\tendDate.toISOString(),\n\t\t);\n\n\t\t// Use Xata's filter to get sightings within date range\n\t\t// First get a raw count to verify filtering using aggregate instead of getCount\n\t\tconst countResult = await xata.db.sightings.aggregate({\n\t\t\ttotalCount: {\n\t\t\t\tcount: \"*\",\n\t\t\t\tfilter: {\n\t\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t});\n\n\t\tconst recordsCount = countResult?.aggs?.totalCount || 0;\n\t\tconsole.log(\"🔍 Count of matching records in date range:\", recordsCount);",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for sightings based on time range\n * Uses Xata's aggregate functionality to efficiently compute stats\n */\nexport async function getSightingsStats(\n\tstartYear = 1940,\n\tendYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n): Promise\u003c{\n\ttotalSightings: number;\n\tbyType: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\tbyYear: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\tbyLocation: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n\ttimeRange: {\n\t\tstartYear: number;\n\t\tendYear: number;\n\t};\n}\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Calculate date range using UTC dates for consistent timezone handling\n\t\tconst startDate = new Date(Date.UTC(startYear, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0));\n\t\tconst endDate = new Date(Date.UTC(endYear, 11, 31, 23, 59, 59, 999));\n\n\t\tconsole.log(\n\t\t\t\"🔍 Using date range:\",\n\t\t\tstartDate.toISOString(),\n\t\t\t\"to\",\n\t\t\tendDate.toISOString(),\n\t\t);\n\n\t\t// Try a direct query first to check if any records exist\n\t\tconst testQuery = await xata.db.sightings.getPaginated({\n\t\t\tpagination: { size: 5 },\n\t\t});\n\n\t\tconsole.log(\n\t\t\t\"🔍 Test query - do records exist?\",\n\t\t\ttestQuery?.records?.length \u003e 0 ? \"Yes\" : \"No\",\n\t\t\t\"Count:\",\n\t\t\ttestQuery?.records?.length || 0,\n\t\t);\n\n\t\tif (testQuery?.records?.length \u003e 0) {\n\t\t\tconsole.log(\n\t\t\t\t\"🔍 Sample record fields:\",\n\t\t\t\tObject.keys(testQuery.records[0]),\n\t\t\t);\n\t\t\tconsole.log(\"🔍 Sample date value:\", testQuery.records[0].date);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Use Xata's aggregate for more efficient querying with proper dateHistogram\n\t\tconst aggregationResults: XataAggregationResult =\n\t\t\tawait xata.db.sightings.aggregate(\n\t\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\t\t// By shape/type\n\t\t\t\t\tshapeDistribution: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttopValues: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcolumn: \"shape\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tsize: 20,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t\t// For years, we'll avoid complex date formatting and just count records\n\t\t\t\t\t// We'll handle date grouping in our code\n\t\t\t\t\tsightingsByYear: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcount: \"*\",\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t\t// By location\n\t\t\t\t\tsightingsByLocation: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttopValues: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcolumn: \"city\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tsize: 30,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\t\t// Filter to specified date range\n\t\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t);",

        "originalContents": "\n\t\ttry {\n\t\t\tstats = await getSightingsStats(startYear, endYear);\n\t\t\tconsole.log(\"🔍 Stats from database aggregation:\", stats);\n\t\t} catch (error) {\n\t\t\tconsole.error(\n\t\t\t\t\"Error fetching stats from aggregation, calculating manually:\",\n\t\t\t\terror,\n\t\t\t);\n\n\t\t\t// Calculate stats manually from the sightings data\n\t\t\tconst byType: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n\t\t\tconst byYear: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n\t\t\tconst byLocation: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n\n\t\t\tfor (const sighting of allSightings) {\n\t\t\t\t// By type\n\t\t\t\tif (sighting.type) {\n\t\t\t\t\tbyType[sighting.type] = (byType[sighting.type] || 0) + 1;\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t// By year\n\t\t\t\tif (sighting.timestamp) {\n\t\t\t\t\tconst fullYear: number = new Date(sighting.timestamp).getFullYear();\n\t\t\t\t\tconst decadeStart = Math.floor(fullYear / 10) * 10;\n\t\t\t\t\tconst decadeLabel = &#96;${decadeStart}-${decadeStart + 9}&#96;;\n\t\t\t\t\tbyYear[decadeLabel] = (byYear[decadeLabel] || 0) + 1;\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t// By location\n\t\t\t\tconst location = sighting.location?.city;\n\t\t\t\tif (location) {\n\t\t\t\t\tbyLocation[location] = (byLocation[location] || 0) + 1;\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tstats = {\n\t\t\t\ttotalSightings: allSightings.length,\n\t\t\t\tbyType,\n\t\t\t\tbyYear,\n\t\t\t\tbyLocation,\n\t\t\t\ttimeRange: {\n\t\t\t\t\tstartYear,\n\t\t\t\t\tendYear,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t};\n\t\t\tconsole.log(\"🔍 Stats calculated manually:\", stats);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsightings: allSightings,\n\t\t\tstats,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error fetching batched sightings:\", error);\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsightings: [],\n\t\t\tstats: {\n\t\t\t\ttotalSightings: 0,\n\t\t\t\tbyType: {},\n\t\t\t\tbyYear: {},\n\t\t\t\tbyLocation: {},\n\t\t\t\ttimeRange: {\n\t\t\t\t\tstartYear: timeRanges[0]?.startYear || 1940,\n\t\t\t\t\tendYear:\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttimeRanges[timeRanges.length - 1]?.endYear ||\n\t\t\t\t\t\tnew Date().getFullYear(),\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t};\n\t}\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Fetch events within a specified time range, with pagination\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query\n * @param limit Maximum number of records to return\n */\nexport async function getEventsByTimeChunk(\n\tstartYear = 1940,\n\tendYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n\tlimit = 100,\n) {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Calculate date range\n\t\tconst startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n\t\tconst endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n\t\t// Use Xata's filter to get events within date range\n\t\tconst eventsRecords = await xata.db.events\n\t\t\t.filter({\n\t\t\t\tdate: {\n\t\t\t\t\t$ge: startDate,\n\t\t\t\t\t$le: endDate,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t.sort(\"date\", \"desc\")\n\t\t\t.getPaginated({\n\t\t\t\tpagination: {\n\t\t\t\t\tsize: limit,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t});\n\n\t\treturn eventsRecords.records;\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error fetching events by time chunk:\", error);\n\t\treturn [];\n\t}\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Helper function to convert Xata records to plain objects for serialization\n * Prevents \"Only plain objects can be passed to Client Components\" errors\n */\nfunction sanitizeXataRecord(record: XataRecord): Record\u003cstring, any\u003e {\n\t// Create a new plain object with only the data properties\n\tconst sanitized: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e = {};\n\n\t// Only copy primitive values and simple objects\n\tfor (const [key, value] of Object.entries(record)) {\n\t\t// Skip the xata object and any methods or class instances\n\t\tif (key === \"xata\" || typeof value === \"function\") continue;\n\n\t\t// Handle date objects\n\t\tif (value instanceof Date) {\n\t\t\tsanitized[key] = value.toISOString();\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Skip non-serializable objects (null prototype objects, classes, etc)\n\t\telse if (\n\t\t\ttypeof value !== \"object\" ||\n\t\t\tvalue === null ||\n\t\t\tArray.isArray(value) ||\n\t\t\tObject.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype\n\t\t) {\n\t\t\tsanitized[key] = value;\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn sanitized;\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Helper function to convert Xata records to plain objects for serialization\n * Prevents \"Only plain objects can be passed to Client Components\" errors\n */\nfunction sanitizeXataRecord(record: XataRecord): Record\u003cstring, any\u003e {\n\t// Create a new plain object with only the data properties\n\tconst sanitized: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e = {};\n\n\t// Only copy primitive values and simple objects\n\tfor (const [key, value] of Object.entries(record)) {\n\t\t// Skip the xata object and any methods or class instances\n\t\tif (key === \"xata\" || typeof value === \"function\") continue;\n\n\t\t// Handle date objects\n\t\tif (value instanceof Date) {\n\t\t\tsanitized[key] = value.toISOString();\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Skip non-serializable objects (null prototype objects, classes, etc)\n\t\telse if (\n\t\t\ttypeof value !== \"object\" ||\n\t\t\tvalue === null ||\n\t\t\tArray.isArray(value) ||\n\t\t\tObject.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype\n\t\t) {\n\t\t\tsanitized[key] = value;\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn sanitized;\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Prepares a summary of combined sightings and events data for AI analysis\n *\n * @param normalizedData - Normalized data array containing both sightings and events\n * @returns Summarized data suitable for AI analysis\n */\nfunction prepareCombinedDataSummary(\n\tnormalizedData: Array\u003c{\n\t\tid: string;\n\t\ttype: \"sighting\" | \"event\";\n\t\ttitle: string;\n\t\tdescription: string;\n\t\tdate: Date;\n\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\tname: string;\n\t\t\tcoordinates?: { lat: number; lng: number };\n\t\t};\n\t\tshape?: string;\n\t\tcategory?: string | string[];\n\t\toriginalItem: SightingData | EventData;\n\t}\u003e,\n) {\n\t// Limit the number of full descriptions to avoid token limits\n\tconst MAX_FULL_DESCRIPTIONS = 50;\n\n\t// Separate sightings and events\n\tconst sightings = normalizedData.filter((item) =\u003e item.type === \"sighting\");\n\tconst events = normalizedData.filter((item) =\u003e item.type === \"event\");\n\n\t// Create a combined summary\n\tconst summary = {\n\t\ttotalSightings: sightings.length,\n\t\ttotalEvents: events.length,\n\t\tlocationData: normalizedData.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\tlocation: item.location?.name || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\tcoordinates: item.location?.coordinates || null,\n\t\t})),\n\t\ttemporalData: normalizedData.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\tdate: item.date,\n\t\t})),\n\t\tshapeData: sightings.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\tshape: item.shape || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t})),\n\t\tcategoryData: events.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t})),\n\t\t// Limit full descriptions to save tokens\n\t\tdescriptions: normalizedData\n\t\t\t.slice(0, MAX_FULL_DESCRIPTIONS)\n\t\t\t.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\t\tdescription: item.description || \"No description\",\n\t\t\t})),\n\t};\n\n\treturn summary;\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Normalize both sightings and events data into a common format for analysis\n *\n * @param sightingsData - Array of sightings data\n * @param eventsData - Array of events data\n * @returns Normalized data array\n */\nfunction normalizeDataForAnalysis(\n\tsightingsData: SightingData[],\n\teventsData: EventData[],\n): Array\u003c{\n\tid: string;\n\ttype: \"sighting\" | \"event\";\n\ttitle: string;\n\tdescription: string;\n\tdate: Date;\n\tlocation: {\n\t\tname: string;\n\t\tcoordinates?: { lat: number; lng: number };\n\t};\n\tshape?: string;\n\tcategory?: string | string[];\n\toriginalItem: SightingData | EventData;\n}\u003e {\n\t// Process sightings\n\tconst normalizedSightings = sightingsData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: \"sighting\" as const,\n\t\t\ttitle: item.title || \"UAP Sighting\",\n\t\t\tdescription: item.content,\n\t\t\tdate: item.timestamp,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: item.location?.city || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates: item.location?.coordinates,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tshape: item.shape || item.category?.[0],\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item,\n\t\t};\n\t});\n\n\t// Process events\n\tconst normalizedEvents = eventsData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: \"event\" as const,\n\t\t\ttitle: item.title || item.name || \"Event\",\n\t\t\tdescription: item.description,\n\t\t\tdate: item.date,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: item.location || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates:\n\t\t\t\t\titem.latitude \u0026\u0026 item.longitude\n\t\t\t\t\t\t? { lat: item.latitude, lng: item.longitude }\n\t\t\t\t\t\t: undefined,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item,\n\t\t};\n\t});\n\n\t// Combine and return\n\treturn [...normalizedSightings, ...normalizedEvents];\n}",

        "contents": "export const analyzeSightingsData = async (\n...\nexport const analyzeSightingsData = async (\n...\nexport const analyzeSightingsData = async (\n\n\n\t\t...\n\n\n\t\t// Create user prompt with the combined data\n\t\tconst userPrompt = &#96;Analyze the following combined UFO sightings and events data and provide structured insights:\\n\\n${JSON.stringify(dataSummary, null, 2)}&#96;;\n\n\t\t// Create streamable value for incremental updates\n\t\tconst stream = createStreamableValue();\n\n\t\t// Make the OpenAI API call with streaming\n\t\tconst { partialObjectStream } = await streamObject({\n\t\t\tmodel: openai.responses(\"gpt-4-turbo-preview\"),\n\t\t\tsystem: systemPrompt,\n\t\t\tprompt: userPrompt,\n\t\t\tschema: analysisSchema,\n\t\t});\n\n\t\tconsole.log(\n\t\t\t\"🚀 ~ analyzeSightingsData ~ API call initiated for combined data analysis\",\n\t\t);\n\n\t\t// Process the streaming response\n\t\tfor await (const partialObject of partialObjectStream) {\n\t\t\tconsole.log(\n\t\t\t\t\"🚀 ~ analyzeSightingsData ~ partialObject update:\",\n\t\t\t\tObject.keys(partialObject).length,\n\t\t\t);\n\t\t\tstream.update(partialObject);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tstream.done;\n\n\t\t// Return both the analysis and the streaming value\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tanalysis: stream.value as SightingsAnalysisResult,\n\t\t\tstreamingValue: stream,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error analyzing combined data:\", error);\n\t\tthrow new Error(\n\t\t\t&#96;Failed to analyze combined data: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}&#96;,\n\t\t);\n\t}\n};",

Based on all the changes we've made, we've addressed the core issue with the "invalid key [filter] in request" error. The key fixes were:

1. Changed the Xata filter syntax from the nested object format to the column-based parameter format: 
   - Changed `.filter({ date: { $ge: startDate, $le: endDate } })` to `.filter("date", { $ge: startDate, $le: endDate })`

2. Removed the second parameter from the aggregate method calls, as this was causing the error.

3. Updated the TypeScript interfaces to properly type the serialized responses in the sightings page.

These changes should resolve the error you were encountering. The issue was that the filter key was being used incorrectly in the Xata client requests. The documentation shows that filters should be applied either:

1. As a column name and filter object for the filter method: `.filter("columnName", filterObject)`
2. Within each aggregation for the aggregate method, not as a second parameter

Try deploying with these changes, and your app should now function correctly without the "invalid key [filter] in request" error.

1. Detects when a year is missing its millennium digit (i.e., year < 1000)

The function also adds detailed logging so you can see both the original malformed dates and the corrected ones.
